message.content:
The loop at lines 9–12 follows the differential chain via `default_table[j]`, but the bounds check `d->default_table[j] >= d->state_count` at line 6 only applies to the initial state. Each subsequent `parent` fetched at line 10 and assigned at line 11 is never revalidated, so a differential state can point to an out-of-range index, causing an out-of-bounds read on the next iteration (or an infinite cycle). The fix would be to recheck each parent inside the loop.

Answer: 11
